"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party supports empowering the self-employed through access to affordable coverage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party supports putting patients and doctors in charge of medical decisions.",
